По образованию — программист. В играх и: A programmer by training. Fix0r in games and on stream.
Мечта, которая привела меня на Twitch: The dream that brought me to Twitch
Когда-то я мечтал стать профессиональным: I once dreamed of becoming a professional PUBG player. I put together my own team, played tournaments and occasionally streamed on Twitch — both competitive matches and casual games.
В 2018 году пробился на тир-2 уровень, н: In 2018, I made it to tier 2, but didn't qualify for PGI in Berlin. Things didn't go to plan after that: I'd left my job for esports and was living on my savings. In 2019, I lost my footing for a year.
Потом вернулся — с новыми силами, планам: Then I came back with fresh energy, plans and ideas. Competitive PUBG was behind me. Next came Apex with some great players, movie nights and jokes whenever we could fit them in. The games change; the joy of hanging out stays.
Начинал капитаном-коллером в команде Rea: I started as captain and shot-caller for RearGuarD, a team I built myself. I later played for Union, Per Aspera Ad Astra and Hello.
Звали в WinStrike и CrowCrowd: с первыми: I had offers from WinStrike and CrowCrowd: the first didn't work out, and I turned down the second. Some former teammates went on to work at NaVi — not as players, just to be clear.
Тогда стрим почти целиком был посвящён c: Back then, the stream was almost entirely about competitive PUBG. Other games only appeared during breaks when I needed a change of pace.
Рад, что ты здесь. Спасибо за поддержку: Glad you're here. Thanks for the support and motivation — I appreciate every one of you. If you feel at home here, stick around and follow!
Игры меняются. Привычка собираться остаё: Games change. Our get-togethers don't. Find the latest schedule and stream links on Telegram.
Three things that hold FC together.
Советуем обходиться без RMT — покупка и: We recommend avoiding RMT: buying or selling in-game currency, items or accounts for real money may break a game's rules and lead to a permanent account ban.
Нам ближе прогресс своими силами и помощ: We prefer earning our progress and helping each other along the way.
Читы и их реклама в сообществе строго за: Cheats and the promotion of cheats are strictly forbidden in the community.
Можно спорить и шутить. Оскорбления, тра: Disagreements and jokes are welcome. Insults, bullying and toxic behavior stay outside.
Помогаем новичкам, держим слово и помним: Help newcomers, keep your word and remember: there's a person on the other side of the screen.
Честь — в игре. Дружба — за её пределами: Honor in the game. Friendship beyond it.
We'll point you in the right direction.
